extraction.name: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
extraction.description: A large and varied database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization using the SMPL body model.
extraction.license: Creative Commons Attribution 2.1 Japan License (for Eyes Japan subset); Publicly available to the research community
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black
extraction.publisher: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
extraction.citeAs: Mahmood, N., Ghorbani, N., Troje, N. F., Pons-Moll, G., & Black, M. J. (2019). AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes. arXiv:1904.03278.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Aggregation of 15 existing optical marker-based mocap datasets. Additionally, the SSM (Synchronized Scans and Markers) dataset was recorded using an OptiTrack mocap system synchronized with a 4D scanning system.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Direct measurement
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Markers may get occluded by the body due to pose. If multiple markers of a particular body part are occluded simultaneously, the optimization may result in unreliable and implausible poses.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Optical marker-based motion capture data (sparse markers) from 15 different datasets.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: In cases where there are no markers present on the hands of the recorded subjects, the hand poses are set to the average pose of the MANO model. A coefficient q is introduced to update the pose prior weight as a factor of the number of missing markers to address occlusion.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Conversion of mocap data into realistic 3D human meshes represented by the SMPL body model using MoSh++. This includes recovering soft-tissue dynamics and realistic hand motion.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manually inspected results to correct or hold out problems due to inherent issues with mocap such as swapped and mislabeled markers.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: MoSh++ fitting process involving two stages: Stage I optimizes poses, shape, and latent marker positions for a subset of frames; Stage II optimizes pose and soft-tissue deformation coefficients for each frame.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Evaluation of MoSh++ accuracy using scan-to-model distances on the SSM dataset. MoSh++ achieves better accuracy than MoSh (7.4mm vs 12.1mm for shape, 8.1mm vs 10.5mm for pose).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be continuously expanded by incorporating more mocap data contributed by the creators and the community.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current runtime for MoSh++ is not real-time. Inherent problems with mocap such as swapped and mislabeled markers require manual inspection.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Animation, visualization, generating training data for deep learning, generating synthetic training data for computer vision tasks
